summary: Iteration 7b web-fallback verification for /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx: all 3 acceptance criteria PASS. On web preview, tapping btn-export creates a Blob (type='application/json') and triggers <a download='planeat-backup-<ts>.json'>.click(), settings-msg shows kind='ok' with the exact text 'Backup scaricato con successo.' on green background rgb(229,237,223). Blob content parses as valid JSON with keys [app='PlanEat', version, exported_at, user, dishes, weekly_plans, shopping_items]. Tapping btn-import-merge creates a document.createElement('input') with type='file', accept='application/json,.json' and invokes .click() (native picker opens), no error banner appears when the picker is cancelled. Regression check: strings 'deprecated', 'writeAsStringAsync', and 'not available on web' are NOT present anywhere on the page. Only pre-existing unrelated console warning still shows: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (third-party RN component, not from settings.tsx).

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx: web branch is cleanly gated by Platform.OS === 'web'; URL.createObjectURL is properly revoked after click; anchor element is appended/removed from body correctly.

settings.tsx: input onchange handler correctly rejects when user cancels ('Nessun file selezionato') — this reject is caught silently at the top-level try/catch, which is why cancelling the picker does not show an error banner. Acceptable, but consider `if (!f) { resolve(''); return; }` and skip the JSON.parse when empty to be more explicit about the cancellation case.
